text: Track the final token, the question mark.
Moving through the layers, its numerical vector updates exclusively using information from preceding tokens.
Exiting the final layer, its numbers completely change, now mathematically describing an inquiry about naming a dog.
On the left, the question mark's vector reflects naming a dog.
On the right, following a prompt about cooking dinner, the exact same symbol produces a vector reflecting choosing a meal.
In this system, identical symbols do not hold fixed definitions.
Their mathematical weight is dictated entirely by the history of the sequence they complete.
